rules.rationale: Defines the empty-case execution transition of the verification model's symbolic integer-list iterator from #iterNext to #iterDone.
Defines the nonempty execution transition of the symbolic integer-list iterator, yielding its integer head and retaining the tail.
Structural projection equation defining scopeMap as the binding map stored in a scope.
Base equation of the addAccSpec mathematical recurrence: an empty input preserves the accumulator.
Recurrence equation for an even-index phase, skipping the head and advancing to the odd-index phase.
Conditional recurrence equation adding an even head encountered during the odd-index phase.
Complementary recurrence equation skipping a non-even head encountered during the odd-index phase.
Macro expansion defining the named addLoopBody proof term as the implementation's loop statements.
Macro expansion defining the named addFunctionBody proof term as the translated function body.
Macro expansion defining solutionModule as the module containing the translated add function.
Summarizes an arbitrary loop directly by addAccSpec and is present in verification.k before both Stage 1 proofs; no earlier proof against a module lacking this exact rule establishes it.
